prompt: Find logging statements that emit raw strings and replace them with structured logs using domain event types from CONTEXT.md.
criterion: All logs use structured domain event types; no unstructured string messages remain.

prompt: Detect entities with fields that map to multiple external systems and extract value objects per CONTEXT.md’s domain modeling rules.
criterion: All multi-system fields are replaced with value objects that encapsulate one domain concept only.

prompt: Identify modules that lack domain-specific unit tests and write tests that verify behavior using only domain language and contracts from CONTEXT.md.
criterion: Every module has at least one unit test using only domain terms and no implementation details.

prompt: Identify test files that mock more than five external dependencies and refactor to use domain-specific test doubles defined in CONTEXT.md.
criterion: Each test uses at most two domain-aligned test doubles; no external system mocks remain.

prompt: Identify configuration files scattered across modules and consolidate them into a single domain-aware config service per ADR-4.
criterion: All configuration is loaded through one domain-config service; no inline or module-specific configs exist.

prompt: Find repositories that return raw SQL or ORM queries and replace them with query objects defined in CONTEXT.md’s query language.
criterion: All data access uses named query objects; no raw queries or ORM fragments remain in repositories.

prompt: Find components that directly call external APIs and wrap them in adapter services aligned with CONTEXT.md’s external interface contracts.
criterion: All external calls go through domain-defined adapters; no direct HTTP or SDK calls remain.

prompt: Find state machines implemented as switch statements and replace them with state objects following ADR-8’s state pattern.
criterion: All state logic is encapsulated in state objects; no switch/case statements remain.

prompt: Locate conditional logic based on environment variables and replace with feature flags managed by a domain feature service per ADR-11.
criterion: All conditionals use feature flags; no environment-variable checks remain in business logic.

prompt: Detect classes with more than five public methods that operate on unrelated domain concepts and split them into focused services per ADR-6.
criterion: Each class has at most three methods, all operating on a single domain concept.
